text_block_list.text:
Just before curfew,
I stopped by the dance studio—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
One-two, one-two...
And the final pose—whoa, whoa!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Urrgh. No matter what I do,
I just can't get that final step right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The teacher asked me to check in, and here you are...
You are still here, Teio-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you do not head home soon, will it not affect
your training tomorrow, desu wa?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But... you saw it too, right, McQueen?
During dance class, the girl next to me got praised.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It made me sooo, soooo frustrated!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because even if I win the race, what's the point
if the girl next to me stands out more during the live?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Be that as it may, it is already time to leave.
Come along, we are going home, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The teacher specifically told me to
"make sure she goes home already"...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! I'm doing this until I'm satisfied!
I don't care about curfew!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please do not say such childish things.
It is embarrassing just listening to you, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Staring at me like that will accomplish nothing!
Enough already, quickly—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Because I want to win at EVERYTHING!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh. Oh, fine, I understand!
What an utterly stubborn person you are...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In exchange, when I say we are finished,
you must obey properly! Understood, desu wa?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Really?! Yay!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then come dance with me too, McQueen♪
Just watching is boring, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wait, how on earth did it come to this, desu wa?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I agreed to watch over you, but
never did I agree to join in your practice...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, here we go!
Music, start!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
!
...Oh, good grief, honestly!
